//sdc: One SDC for PnR, signoff and RCX, shared with make sta. Setting these replaces LibreLane's generic base.sdc entirely.
//excluded_cells: Delay buffers, kept out of synthesis and PnR. The resizer was choosing clkdlybuf4s25_1 to fix max-fanout violations -- a clock DELAY cell used as a drive buffer, ~1.6ns each. Nine of them accounted for 17.22ns of a 27.34ns critical path. The PDK's drc_exclude.cells already drops 4s15_1 and 4s18_1 but not the rest of the family. dlygate*/dlymetal* are deliberately left available: they are the hold-fix cells and hold margin is only +0.13ns.
//: Start at 20ns (50 MHz). Tighten only after synthesis closes.
//floorplan: Utilisation is the first knob to turn if routing fails. The register file dominates area, so start low and raise it once the design routes.
//sizing: Let LibreLane pick the die from utilisation rather than fixing it by hand until you know your area.
//synthesis: SYNTH_STRATEGY AREA 0 / DELAY 0..4. DELAY strategies trade cells for speed -- worth sweeping once the flow runs end to end.
//drc: Magic and Netgen signoff are on by default in Classic. Leave them on -- a design that routes but fails DRC is not done.
